body:
Starting early May of 2005 (i was 19 years old) Meth came back around my area and the masses were more then excited. I used meth religously every day starting in May and used it intill the first week of September. thats 4 months of constant daily high doses, most likely about half a gram to a gram each day. I lost my job, friends, and lastly my home . But I have managed to basicly stop all drug use except a time here or there, I'm back home, im healthy and relativly sane... maybe. I have a wonderful girl friend who's back ground is no different then mine and we're each others motivation to do something wour lives. if i've managed to turn things around and better myself, we all can, so remember its never hopeless
